# hetznerrobot_rdns (Data Source)

Reads the PTR (reverse DNS) record for a Hetzner Robot IPv4 or IPv6 address.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) The IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ptr` (String) The PTR (hostname) currently associated with the address. Empty if no PTR is set.
